title: Parabens: FDA Status, State Bans & Global Restrictions for Food and Cosmetics
excerpt: Parabens face a rapidly shifting regulatory landscape — from California's food and cosmetics bans to EU concentration limits and 20+ state-level restrictions. Here's what food and cosmetics companies need to know.
seo_title: Parabens Regulatory Status 2026 | FDA, State Bans & EU Restrictions
seo_description: Comprehensive regulatory intelligence on parabens (methylparaben, propylparaben, butylparaben) in food and cosmetics. FDA GRAS status, California AB 418 & AB 2762 bans, EU limits, MoCRA implications, and compliance deadlines.

structured_data.fda_status: GRAS (food: methylparaben 21 CFR 184.1490, propylparaben 21 CFR 184.1670); no premarket approval required for cosmetics under MoCRA

key_deadlines.event: California AB 2762 — isopropylparaben and isobutylparaben banned in cosmetics
Maryland HB 643 and Washington Toxic-Free Cosmetics Act — paraben bans in cosmetics
Vermont S.25 — paraben ban in cosmetics
California AB 418 — propylparaben banned in food products
Oregon SB 546 — paraben ban in cosmetics
